course_name_original: Methoden und Hilfsmittel in der Produktentstehung
course_name_en: Methods and Tools in Product Creation
prerequisites: Successful completion of the modules to be completed in the 1st and 2nd semesters according to the study plan

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to identify problems in engineering processes and structures, search for solutions, work out and select alternatives.
Students are able to apply the learned engineering methodologies in practice and are thus able to engineer complex technical systems (e.g. automotive components).
Students can explain the functionality of CAD and PDM systems and describe their possible applications.
Students can use exemplary scenarios to select a CAD system and plan its introduction in the company.
Students derive potential that can be tapped using interfaces to other systems (see CAE, Digital and Virtual Product Creation).

syllabus_topics: Challenges and trends in Product Creation
Methods and procedures of handling complexity in the context of mass customization
Product Development in the Context of CAD and PDM
CA Technologies and Interfaces in Product Development
Internal Data Structures and 3D Modeling Kernels
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded if the module examination is passed. The module is weighted by the number of its credit points (factor: 1).
